activity.notes: Pitt's first premiership began in 1783 under the Kingdom of Great Britain. ATLAS splits the continuous ministry at the constitutional creation of the United Kingdom on 1 January 1801 rather than back-projecting the later polity over the whole first ministry.

sources.title: History of William Pitt 'The Younger'
sources.citation_text: GOV.UK records Pitt's premierships in 1783-1801 and 1804-1806 and the Act of Union that created the United Kingdom.

sources.title: William Pitt the Younger (Whig/Tory 1783-1801, 1804-1806)
sources.citation_text: The UK History of Government account records the 1 January 1801 union, Pitt's resignation on 14 March 1801, and his return in May 1804.
